summary: Mechanical Engineer with a Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering (Université Clermont Auvergne) and Engineering Training from ENSAM Meknès. Specialized in mechanical design, non-linear finite element simulation (Abaqus, COMSOL, Ansys), structural mechanics, vibration analysis, and GD&T. Over three years of industrial R&D experience in France (SLB Group, Sigma) leading 3D CAD modeling (SolidWorks, CATIA V5, Creo), parametric simulation, sensor integration, physical testing, and DFMEA/RCA failure analysis. Eager to leverage strong mechanical engineering and simulation fundamentals to drive next-generation e-bike powertrain and drivetrain innovations at E2 DRIVES.
